arguments.summary: A critical firewall integrity alert was triggered by suspicious activity originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), a high-criticality finance workstation. Investigation confirmed malicious activity including Cobalt Strike beaconing (T1071.001), encoded PowerShell execution (T1566.001), lateral movement attempts via SMB, and use of living-off-the-land binaries (rundll32.exe). The source IP initially reported (10.0.5.14) was incorrect; the true compromised host was 10.0.5.42. No containment actions were approved during the Admin phase, indicating a failure in response execution. The sandbox incorrectly classified the payload as clean, highlighting a detection gap.

timeline.description: Initial outbound HTTPS connection to known-malicious IP 198.51.100.23 from WS-FIN-042.
Suspicious rundll32.exe process spawned from Temp directory on WS-FIN-042.
IDS alerts on Cobalt Strike beaconing from WS-FIN-042 to 198.51.100.23.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, indicating credential access attempt.
Successful SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50, confirming lateral movement.
Code analysis identifies PowerShell script using Invoke-Expression and remote payload download (T1059.001, T1105).
Sandbox returns false negative; payload marked as clean despite high-risk indicators.
Firewall integrity alert triggered, but based on incorrect source IP (10.0.5.14).
Response actions (firewall block, EPP quarantine, IAM disable, Ansible isolation) denied due to misalignment with evidence or invalid parameters.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Download and Execute
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    - Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
    - CommandLine|contains: 
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'WebClient'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1105/
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative scripts
author: SOC Team

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects embedded configuration in Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 2d 65 78 65 63 75 74 65 }
        $b = "beacon" fullword ascii
        $c = "http-get" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
